description: Three small bowls sit on a blue-covered surface in front of a pink pillow: two light-blue bowls and one orange bowl. The right hand reaches to the nearer light-blue bowl, grips and lifts it up and to the right, then lowers it into the orange bowl; next, the right hand grabs the other light-blue bowl from the center and places it on top of the first, forming a stacked nest inside the orange bowl, while the left hand stays nearby without touching anything.
